part.text:
I couldn't open your profile. I took a screenshot and confirmed the Bluesky feed is showing, with the profile avatar at the far right of the bottom tab bar (roughly 88% across and 93% down the screen). But this environment gives me no way to send a tap to the simulator. `simctl` has no tap or touch subcommand, and no simulator input tool such as idb or axe is installed.

There is a `cliclick` binary in a shim directory on the host. I did not use it. It would send synthetic host mouse events, which the task rules out.

If you can enable a tap-capable input tool for the simulator, or tap the avatar yourself, I can take a fresh screenshot to confirm the profile opened.
